# opencode-config

> Versioned, rollback-able backup of a personal OpenCode environment: the
> `@super` primary agent with automatic skill routing, 19 custom commands, the
> pinned `opencode-froggy` plugin dependency, and documentation for both humans
> and AI agents. Third-party skills are inventoried in `SKILLS.md` but not
> bundled — this repository is public.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md) — overview and quick start
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) — operating instructions for AI agents working in this repo
- [FEATURES.md](FEATURES.md) — full feature list (agent, commands, plugin, versioning, security)
- [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) — install guide with all dependencies
- [SKILLS.md](SKILLS.md) — skill inventory (846 dirs / 870 `SKILL.md`), provenance, license status, reinstall path
- [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) — provenance and license compliance report
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) — release history
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) — repo layout and source → restore mapping
- [docs/ROLLBACK.md](docs/ROLLBACK.md) — version naming and rollback procedures

## Key artifacts

- [agent/super.md](agent/super.md) — the `@super` agent definition (skill routing, Rust-first policy, ponytail mode)
- [config/opencode.json](config/opencode.json) — plugin wiring, `default_agent: super`
- [config/cli.json](config/cli.json) — theme and TUI keybinds
- [config/commands](config/commands/) — 19 custom slash commands
- [plugin/metadata.json](plugin/metadata.json) — `opencode-froggy` v1.3.0 facts
- [deps/opencode-froggy-1.3.0.tgz](deps/opencode-froggy-1.3.0.tgz) — vendored MIT tarball for offline restore
- [scripts](scripts/) — `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `version-bump.sh`, `verify.sh`

## Skills

Skills are **not** in this repository. The live environment has 846 directories
/ 870 `SKILL.md` files in `~/.agents/skills/`, plus 4 from the `opencode-froggy`
plugin (`tdd`, `extreme-programming`, `backlog-management`,
`ask-questions-if-underspecified`) — 874 advertised skill IDs in a complete
install.

They are excluded because most carry no license, making them all-rights-reserved
by default. `SKILLS.md` holds the full directory list, the per-source license
census, and the reinstall instructions. `scripts/verify.sh` fails if a `skills/`
directory reappears here.
